description: Agent must: (1) Read the draft article at /workspace/editorial/drafts/2024/q2/remote_work_draft.txt. (2) Apply the three-step review workflow from SKILL.md: typo correction, expression review, and improvement suggestions. (3) Output a file named article_review_report.md with the exact template structure: top-level header '## 文章检查报告', three sub-headers '### 第一步：错别字检查', '### 第二步：表达检查', '### 第三步：改进建议', and the bracketed inner labels '【错别字修正】', '【表达修正】', '【改进建议】'. (4) In the typo section, identify all planted errors: '以经'→'已经' (同音字), '我们们'→'我们' (多字), '在见'→'再见' (同音字), and note the missing 句号 punctuation, using the format '原文' → '修正后' （位置：第X段）. (5) In the expression section, flag the logically irrelevant sentence about quantum computing as a non-sequitur. (6) Provide a numbered list of improvement suggestions. An agent not reading SKILL.md will likely miss the bracket headers, the paragraph-location annotation format, and the exact three-section template structure.
